title: Teams case chat sync
use_case: Post a card to a Teams channel when a case is created, changes status, severity, assignee or title, or gets a comment, with a link to the case. With the library's chat bridge, people in the channel can set the status or comment from Teams.
trigger: Platform Events, source Case, events Create, Update and Comment Added. Leave When does this playbook run? at Always; the playbook's own settings do the scoping. It can also run by hand from a case.
connections: Taegis.MicrosoftTeams 1.2.4, the Microsoft Teams connector Sophos manages, set to a Teams Workflows webhook URL
Taegis.Case 1.0.5, the case connector Sophos manages, to read the case
requires: Microsoft Teams with Workflows, and Sophos Fusion playbooks under Security Operations > Automations. Two-way also needs the chat bridge in this repo and a Teams outgoing webhook.
mdr_note: Sophos MDR doesn't run or watch this playbook, and it doesn't change what Sophos MDR does. With Managed by at any, Sophos MDR cases are posted too, comments included, so check who is in the channel.
rollback: None for posted cards. Turn the playbook off to stop posting.
author: Aaronjacobs000
notes: On 2026-10-21 it passed playbookValidateDSLV2 with no errors or warnings, and a renamed copy ran by hand in a Sophos Fusion tenant against a test case, with case and comment events given as inputs: the Teams connector posted the card to a test endpoint standing in for the Workflows webhook, and it was not shown in Teams. A case post arrived; a comment starting with [chat-sync] and an event with no comment text sent nothing; another comment arrived with its text. A case-triggered run is untested: the Cases API refused to create a test case that day.
